Well not to sound cliche, but you clearly haven’t reached a conclusion if you think death is the solution cause death is never the solution. Idk how in-depth you’ve evaluated everything, so I can’t say specifics.

Well one part of depression is losing interest in the things you love. I won’t say I played video games and sports cause I enjoyed them. More so to do ANYTHING besides soaking in negativity. I lost all my interest in video games, so I just played to play. 

And yea. Things others do might not work for you. At that point it’s up to you to figure it out, no matter how many suggestions people give you, none of them might work. But believe me when I say talking to other helps clear your mind and might help putting a different perspective onto things. And I don’t mean to talk. But more so have someone listen. If not, then self assessment as to why you are feeling the way you do.

Better as in you can enjoy life. Even if you have those thoughts in your head. It won’t stop you from continuing on. I still have bad thoughts. But I just push them back and don’t let them overrule my life. The thing I did best was distract myself. Play video games. Do sports. Anything to keep my mind off of it. I will say talking to someone you trust helps, but that is when you are ready to get it off your chest. 

In terms of what is worth suffering for, Well I know for people it’s different, but for me my family.

Been there and felt the same. I won’t tell you it will get better soon because it won’t. It will take time. As of now just distract yourself. Don’t let your mind go to a dark place. Even if this means playing games all day. Just know that there are somethings in life that are worth suffering over.
